# staff-postmortem

> Blameless Staff incident-review form. Evidence-first. Copy the template. Examples are fictional.

## Primary

- [Template](docs/template.md): blank form (summary, quantified impact, UTC timeline, detection, systemic factors, what went well, SMART actions)
- [Checkout latency example](docs/example-checkout-latency.md): dense fictional fill (constraint, decision, before/after)
- [Short spike example](docs/example-short-spike.md): fictional ~2 min identity 502; when a short burst still gets a write-up
- [References](docs/references.md): public structure links only

## Also

- [When to write](docs/when-to-write.md): severity threshold, when not to write a novel, 48-hour draft
- [Severity](docs/severity.md): Sev vs P
- [README](README.md): map
